characters.name: ORAV OTT
characters.description: Väike oranž orav koheva sabaga, seljas roheline kampsun, suured uudishimulikud silmad ja rõõmsameelne naeratus. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: SIIL SAMMI
characters.description: Väike pruun siil pehmete okastega, kaelas kollane sall, sõbralik ilme ja armsa välimusega. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: Sügisene aed
locations.description: Sunny autumn garden with green grass partially covered in colorful red and yellow leaves, a wooden fence in the background, a few apple trees with red apples, bright warm sunlight. Cute cartoon style.

pages.text: ORAV OTT JA SIIL SAMMI ON AIAS.
pages.scene: Orav Ott, a small orange squirrel in a green sweater, and Siil Sammi, a small brown hedgehog with a yellow scarf, stand side by side in a sunny autumn garden. The grass has scattered colorful red and yellow leaves. A low wooden fence and apple trees are in the background under bright cheerful morning sunlight. Cartoon style.

Orav Ott and Siil Sammi look around at the garden floor, which is covered with many bright red, orange, and yellow fallen leaves. Ott points at the colorful leaves excitedly while Sammi smiles. The background shows the same wooden fence and apple trees under warm sunny skies. Cartoon style.

Orav Ott holds a small red garden rake and Siil Sammi holds a small blue garden rake. They are actively raking the red and yellow autumn leaves together in the garden. Bright sunlight illuminates the scene. Cartoon style.
Orav Ott and Siil Sammi stand proudly next to a growing pile of colorful autumn leaves in the garden. They hold their small rakes and look at the leaf pile with cheerful expressions. Cartoon style.

A very large, tall pile of fluffy red, orange, and yellow leaves sits in the middle of the garden. Orav Ott and Siil Sammi look up at the impressive leaf pile with wide excited eyes and happy smiles. Cartoon style.
Orav Ott leaps high into the air with arms outstretched, jumping straight into the big pile of colorful leaves. Siil Sammi watches in delight from the side in the sunny garden. Cartoon style.
Siil Sammi jumps happily into the large pile of leaves right beside Orav Ott. Leaves splash and scatter into the air as Sammi lands into the pile. Cartoon style.

Bright yellow and red autumn leaves float high into the sunny air around Orav Ott and Siil Sammi as they splash playfully inside the leaf pile. Both characters look up at the flying leaves with joy. Cartoon style.

Orav Ott and Siil Sammi sit happily together inside the soft pile of autumn leaves, with a few leaf leaves resting on top of their heads. They are giggling and laughing merrily in the warm autumn sunlight. Cartoon style.
